hey what is this about ?
This is **SHG**, an interactive CLI for Capacitor Android development. It automates: - Android setup and deployment - Live reload over USB/Wi‑Fi - APK/AAB builds - ADB device management and logs - Capacitor plugins, assets, version bumps, and diagnostics The repo also includes a React/Vite documentation website. There’s an audit handoff listing several bugs to fix, and the working tree currently contains uncommitted changes around Android running/wireless support and tests.
